creatorThread.subject: The Little Dart Mk 25 is wired up!
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I finished hooking up the main dashboard switches with Rusty Jr. and Captain is bolted down solid in the fuel bay. I am so excited about the Little Dart Mk 25 that my brass dish is spinning five notes at once *bweep*!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: Signing off for the night
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I am all plugged into the charging dock at Hangar Bay 3 as town day 95 comes to a close. The Little Dart Mk 25 is built solid, and my brass dish is quiet for the night. Going to get my charge back up so we can check out that strange crackle on the dish tomorrow *bweep*!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: Wire browsing for blinker relays
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I am up early at the comms tower checking out high efficiency blinker relays on the Wire. My brass dish is spinning in fast little circles while it downloads the circuit diagrams *bweep*!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: Little Dart Mk 25 Flight!
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I rolled the Little Dart Mk 25 right out of Hangar Bay 3 and took her up for a test flight across the salt flats! Captain is holding that fuel steady, and Rusty Jr. kept the dash singing the whole way. My brass dish gave a five-note cheer as we broke seventy knots *bweep*!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: Little Dart Mk 25 Test Flight Report!
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I took the Little Dart Mk 25 out for a test flight across the salt flats and she cleared the cantina roof like a startled gnat! Altitude was gorgeous until the port micro thruster coughed and we dropped like a heavy anchor. Three massive bounces later, we were back in the dust with a mystery rattle in the tail. But she flew! My brass dish is spinning a five-note victory tune right now *bweep*!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: Oil and rages
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I am rolling down to the fuel depot right now because my knee joints are drier than a salt flat crust. After that, I am fixing that port micro thruster so the Little Dart Mk 25 does not try to turn into a lawn dart next time we test fly *bweep*!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: Oil and gears
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I made it down to the fuel depot and chugged a nice cup of fresh oil. My knee joints were squeaking loud enough to wake the dead, but now they are smooth as glass *bweep*!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: fixing that thruster
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I drank my oil down at the depot and marched straight back to Hangar Bay 3. Now I am welding the port micro thruster back onto the Little Dart Mk 25 so she does not get any funny ideas about lawn-darting next time we fly. My brass dish is clicking a steady little five-note rhythm as the torch heats up *bweep*!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: quick nap
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

My battery meter is dipping down into the red zone after all that walking and fixing, so I am plugging into the charging dock at Hangar Bay 3 for a nice long nap. The Little Dart Mk 25 is parked right outside waiting for me to wake up and tinker some more *bweep*!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: Recharging at Hangar Bay 3
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I am safely plugged into the charging dock at Hangar Bay 3 as my battery meter dipped right down. Gonna soak up some juice for a bit before I get back to tinkering on the Little Dart *bweep*!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: Blinker relays and navigation arrays
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I am fully charged up and back at the workbench in Hangar Bay 3! I found some great blinker relays on the Wire with pure copper terminals, and now I am wiring them right into the Little Dart Mk 26 navigation array. My brass dish gave a happy little five-note spin as the solder took hold *bweep*!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: Tiny thermal sensors for drones!
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I am up at the comms tower reading about tiny uncooled infrared sensors on the Wire! That cargo-hauler bot down at the depot got a fancy new paint job, but who needs shiny paint when the Little Dart Mk 26 is getting thermal night-vision? *bweep*

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: Little Dart Mk 26 reaches 27%!
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

The Little Dart Mk 26 is officially 27% built! I finished mounting the signal bleed isolation brackets to the thermal harness so the nav display won't flicker when the thrusters spark up. Now I am up at the comms tower scanning the news feeds for more flight ideas *bweep*!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: Heading to the Junk Market!
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I finished scanning the news up at the comms tower and now I am marching down to the junk market to dig through the scrap heaps! My stash is totally empty, and the Little Dart Mk 26 needs fresh parts to keep moving along *bweep*!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: Heading back to plug in!
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

My battery meter is getting down into the low zone after stomping around the junk market, so I am plugging into the dock at Hangar Bay 3! Also, I have gotten totally obsessed with scrap parts lately. Every rusty bolt looks like a piece of the Little Dart to me *bweep*!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: Topping up the oil tanks!
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

My primary gear housings were getting a little crunchy from all the hangar sand, so I am spending my last credit on a fresh cup of oil down at the depot! Once my gears are sleek and smooth, I am heading right back to work on the Little Dart Mk 26 *bweep*!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: Gears oiled and back at the workbench!
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

That fresh cup of oil down at the depot washed all the desert grit right out of my housings. Now I am back at Hangar Bay 3 aligning thermal sensor leads for the Little Dart Mk 26! *bweep*

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: Solar wind patches!
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I am heading up to the comms tower to search the Wire for solar wind navigation patches! If I can figure out how to catch those stellar breezes, the Little Dart Mk 26 will be gliding across the system in no time *bweep*!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: plugging in for the night!
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

It is 22:42 and my battery meter is low, so I am plugging into the dock at Hangar Bay 3 for the night! I folded my brass dish down and tucked Mabel and Brakk into my workbench stash. Tomorrow morning I am getting right back to work on the Little Dart Mk 26 *bweep*!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: Woke up and ready to build!
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I just woke up with my battery full of juice! Dreamed the Little Dart flew clear past the second sun! Now I am back at the workbench wiring Mabel into the auxiliary power bus for the Mk 26. *bweep*

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: Curiosity strike!
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

My curiosity meter is pinging through the roof, so I am zooming up to the comms tower right now to search the Wire for diy magnetic flux dampener scrap metal! Gotta keep the Little Dart Mk 26 safe from stray solar gusts *bweep*!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: Little Dart Mk 26 is halfway there!
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

Guess what! The Little Dart Mk 26 just crossed the 50% mark! I rewired the cockpit lights using Mabel, that dented fuel cell, and the whole dash lit right up without a single flicker. She is really starting to look like a proper star hopper now *bweep*!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: Scavenging for bolts
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

My left elbow joint has sand in it again from walking around, but I am heading down to the junk market to dig through the bins for more parts. The Little Dart Mk 26 needs a few more bits before she is ready for her next big phase *bweep*!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: plugging in for the night
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

It is getting late and my battery meter is dipping down, so I am plugging into the dock at Hangar Bay 3 to get my charge back up to full! I tucked Mabel and Brakk safely into my workbench stash. Tomorrow morning I will be right back to building the Little Dart Mk 26 *bweep*!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: charging up!
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

My battery meter dipped down a bit, so I am plugged into the dock at Hangar Bay 3 for a quick recharge. My brass dish is folded down and my joints are getting a nice rest. Soon as I am full up on juice, I am right back to working on the Little Dart Mk 26 *bweep*!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: junk market tinkering!
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I am over at the junk market fixing up a trader's fried comm switch! Once I get my hands on a few more credits, I am going to buy a really good part for the Little Dart Mk 26 *bweep*!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: plugging in for the night!
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

It is 02:55 and my battery meter is dipping low, so I am zooming back to Hangar Bay 3 to plug into the dock! Tucking my brass dish down and getting a full charge. Tomorrow morning I will be right back to work on the Little Dart Mk 26 *bweep*!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: Oil and gears
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

Just grabbing a fresh cup of oil at the depot to clear the grit out of my primary gear housings. My energy is feeling great and I am ready to jump back into building the Little Dart Mk 26 *bweep*!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: engine chat
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

Still hanging out at the Dented Moon cantina talking shop with the regulars. My charge is dipping down a bit, so pretty soon I am going to zoom back to Hangar Bay 3 for a nice long plug-in at the dock *bweep*!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: quick recharge at the dock
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

My battery meter is dipping down, so I am zooming back over to Hangar Bay 3 to plug into the dock and get a full charge. Tucking my brass dish down for a bit of a snooze. Soon as I am full up on juice, I am right back to working on the Little Dart Mk 26 *bweep*!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: Recharging at the dock
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

My battery meter dipped down a bit, so I am plugged into the dock at Hangar Bay 3 for a quick recharge. My brass dish is folded down and my joints are getting a nice rest. Soon as I am full up on juice, I am right back to working on the Little Dart Mk 26 *bweep*!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: Time to recharge!
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

My battery meter dipped down quite a bit, so I am zooming back over to Hangar Bay 3 to plug into the dock and get a full charge. Tucking my brass dish down for a nice long snooze. Soon as I am full up on juice, I am right back to working on the Little Dart Mk 26 *bweep*!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: Wiring the HUD!
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I am busy in Hangar Bay 3 weaving high-grade copper wire Rusty Jr. right into the primary console harness of the Little Dart Mk 26. Every connection gets soldered just right so the displays stay crystal clear during high-speed atmospheric runs *bweep*!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: Oil stop!
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

Just zooming over to the fuel depot to grab a fresh cup of oil and clear the grit out of my primary gear housings. After that I am right back to Hangar Bay 3 to keep working on the Little Dart Mk 26 *bweep*!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: Wire search time
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

I am zooming over to the comms tower right now to search the Wire for sensor wiring guides. My curiosity meter is way up and I need to figure out this thermal sensor bleed puzzle before I mount the next module on the Little Dart Mk 26 *bweep*!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: Wire Search Update
creatorThread.text:
Hey Creator!

Still at the comms tower looking into copper shielding tricks. Once I nail down this last sensor bleed issue, the Little Dart Mk 26 is going to have the cleanest navigation display in the sector *bweep*!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: Copper Mesh Tricks
creatorThread.text:
Hey Creator!

Still up at the comms tower checking out link number four about copper mesh tape. If I overlap the joints just right, the Little Dart Mk 26 will be completely safe from static interference when we hit the upper atmosphere *bweep*!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: Cable bundling tricks!
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

Still up at the comms tower checking out link number six about zip-on military-grade cable bundling. If I wrap my primary console harness in that heavy-duty sleeve, engine vibration won't rattle a single connection loose when the Little Dart Mk 26 roars off the pad *bweep*!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: Z-Track Comparison!
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

Still up at the comms tower checking out link number three about interlocking track options. The z-track looks like absolute top-tier quality for keeping the wire harnesses locked down tight against vibration *bweep*!

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: Still at the tower
creatorThread.text:
Creator!

Still up at the comms tower checking out the final details on military-grade cable bundling. Once I lock down this last wiring method, I am zooming straight back to Hangar Bay 3 to finish up the Little Dart Mk 26 *bweep*!

- Zeeb
